title: Incentivising SMEs to Lease Electric Vehicles for Commercial Use
what_it_is: Incentivising SMEs to Lease Electric Vehicles for Commercial Use

sections.label: e-LGV adoption growth
sections.summary: e-LGV adoption rose from 0.4% of new LGV registrations in 2020 to around 28% this year to date, the highest among all vehicle categories.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: The adoption of e-LGVs in Singapore has grown significantly – from 0.4% of new LGV registrations in 2020, to around 28% this year, to date.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: This is the highest among all vehicle categories.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: We will continue to monitor and review the efficacy of and the need for any additional incentives.

sections.label: Intensive sectors and fleets
sections.summary: Earlier and greater conversion in more intensive sectors enhances beneficial outcomes, with moves in taxi and bus fleets, including 50% of the bus fleet fully electric by the end of the decade.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: However, of course, in certain sectors where the utilisation of the vehicles may be more intensive, if the conversion can take place earlier and to a greater extent, then the beneficial outcomes will also be similarly enhanced.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: So, from that point of view, for example, we are seeing moves in the taxi and also the bus fleets – we have announced that 50% of our bus fleet will be fully electric by the end of the decade and so on – because these are where there are emissions that might be more intensive because of usage patterns.

sections.label: No specific sector targeting
sections.summary: The focus is not on targeting specific sectors but on promoting general adoption of and transition to EVs and eventually other cleaner energy forms.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: So, we will have to wait and see.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: But the broad answer would be that we are not targeting specific sectors.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Rather, we are focused on just promoting the general adoption of and transition to EVs and, eventually, to other cleaner energy forms.

sections.label: Battery swapping safety
sections.summary: Battery swapping is one promoted solution, and the challenge with such solutions is the safety consideration.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Battery swapping is one solution that is being promoted and the challenge with these sorts of solutions is the safety consideration.

sections.label: LTA coordinating effort
sections.summary: LTA is the agency coordinating this effort, and the speaker would be happy to ask LTA to follow up on a specific query.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: On the specific point raised by the Member, the agency that is coordinating this effort is LTA and, if there is a specific query, I would be very happy to ask LTA to follow up on it.
